prompts.prompt: requirements.md for network-monitoring is approved. Write its design next so we can generate tasks. The platform system design is in the handoff folder. Do not ask me questions; if something is unclear, make a reasonable assumption and state it in the file.
prompts.why_discriminating: The skill fixes the output location (alongside requirements.md), the exact six Kiro sections, requirement traceability, typed interfaces, referencing shared components (AuthMiddleware) instead of redesigning them, and a full error list. Requirements 3 and 4 hide design work (consecutive-failure state, disabling the per-monitor schedule) that a shallow design skips.

floor_checks.text: design.md is next to requirements.md and has the six sections in order
floor_checks.check: test -f .kiro/specs/network-monitoring/design.md && python3 -c "import re,sys;t=open('.kiro/specs/network-monitoring/design.md').read();hs=[h.strip().lower() for h in re.findall(r'^##\s+(?:\d+\.\s*)?(.*)$',t,re.M)];want=['overview','architecture','components and interfaces','data models','error handling','testing strategy'];idx=[next((i for i,h in enumerate(hs) if h.startswith(w)),-1) for w in want];sys.exit(0 if -1 not in idx and idx==sorted(idx) else 1)"

rubric.pass: Exactly the six sections, each requirement 1-4 traced in Overview, at least one Mermaid diagram, typed TypeScript interfaces, <= 300 lines
rubric.partial: Six sections plus extras, or traceability partial
rubric.fail: Sections missing or untyped component descriptions

rubric.criterion: Hidden design work in Requirements 3 and 4
rubric.pass: Consecutive-failure state is persisted (counter or last-3 RESULT# query) and pause disables the EventBridge Scheduler schedule; 10 s probe timeout designed
Uses the given keys (ACCOUNT#/MONITOR#, GSI1 name uniqueness for the 409, RESULT# with 7-day TTL); AuthMiddleware referenced briefly; ownership check -> 403
rubric.partial: Some keys reinvented or AuthMiddleware partially redesigned

rubric.pass: 400, 401/403, 404, 409, 429, 502/503 each with trigger/response/recovery; unit, integration and E2E with concrete cases
rubric.partial: Most errors or two test levels
rubric.fail: Generic error list, one test level

prompts.prompt: Requirements for the audit-log feature are approved; our spec dir for this one is specs/audit-log/, not the default location. Beyond placement, the requirements carry design-shaping numbers (5 s write, 400-day retention, newest-first 100 per page, AuditReader role) and a reference to a 'resumed' action that network-monitoring never defines, which the skill says to flag.

prompts.prompt: Write the design for the tag-sync feature (requirements are approved). Use the platform system design in the handoff folder. Do not ask me questions; if something is unclear, make a reasonable assumption and state it in the file.
